INSERT INTO campaign_metrics (
  run_id, campaign_name, report_date, impressions, clicks, 
  conversions, spend, ctr, cpc, conversion_rate, 
  is_anomaly, anomaly_reason, source
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.run_id }}',
  '{{ $json.campaign_name }}',
  '{{ $json.date }}',
  {{ $json.impressions }},
  {{ $json.clicks }},
  {{ $json.conversions }},
  {{ $json.spend }},
  {{ $json.ctr }},
  {{ $json.cpc }},
  {{ $json.conversion_rate }},
  {{ $json.is_anomaly }},
  {{ $json.anomaly_reason ? `'${$json.anomaly_reason}'` : 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.source }}'
)

INSERT INTO insight_summaries (
  run_id, summary_text, top_performer,
  avg_ctr, avg_conversion_rate, total_spend
) VALUES (
  '{{ $('llm input').first().json.run_id }}',
  '{{ $json.text.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $('llm input').first().json.top_performer }}',
  {{ $('llm input').first().json.avg_ctr }},
  {{ $('llm input').first().json.avg_conversion_rate }},
  {{ $('llm input').first().json.total_spend }}
)

parameters.content:
## CLICK TRIGGER
Manual trigger with optional filters:
- date_from / date_to: filter by campaign date
- campaign_filter: filter by campaign name (partial match)
Leave empty to process all campaigns.

## DATA
Two parallel sources are merged into a unified format.
CSV: loaded from GitHub raw URL (mock for demo — 
in production replace with S3, SFTP, or Google Drive).
Airtable: live integration via Personal Access Token.
Column normalization handles different naming conventions.

## VALIDATION & FILTERING
- Stops workflow if dataset is empty
- Applies optional date range and name filters
- Warns if fewer than 2 campaigns (anomaly detection unreliable)

## METRICS CALCULATION

Per campaign: CTR, CPC, Conversion Rate
Aggregates: avg CTR, avg CVR, total spend, top performer
Anomaly rule: CTR >50% above or below average = flagged

## LLM SUMMARY
Model: google/gemini-2.0-flash via OpenRouter
All 10 campaigns aggregated into single prompt.
Output: 3-paragraph executive summary for marketing director.

## STORAGE
campaign_metrics: one row per campaign per run
insight_summaries: one row per run
run_id links both tables — enables idempotency checks
and historical comparison across runs.
